newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse Air Brake gets FTC clearance.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse Air Brake gets FTC clearance.

text.p: Westinghouse Air Brake Co confirmed on Friday that the U.S. Department of Justice and the Federal Trade Commission completed their investigation and granted early termination of the waiting period required before the company could buy the Vapor Inc unit of Mark IV Industries Inc.

Vapor makes door systems for the rail and transit bus markets in North America and the United Kingdom. The Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period ended after the company said it would divest itself of its 50 percent interest in Westcode Inc, which has a share of the transit door system market.

"While obtaining DOJ approval is a critical step in the process, we still have a number of issues to work out with Mark IV," said William Kassling, Westinghouse Air Brake's chairman, chief executive and president.
He said the company retained an option to repurchase its interest in Westcode if the Vapor deal is not completed.
"We are hopeful that we will be able to make a more definitive announcement within a month."
